package flowexperiment

import (
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/npillmayer/khipu"
	"github.com/npillmayer/khipu/contracts"
	"github.com/npillmayer/khipu/dimen"
	"github.com/npillmayer/typography/glyphing/paragraph"
	"github.com/npillmayer/uax/bidi"
)

// Keep this pre-existing admission counterexample reproducible. An upstream
// fix enables the continuation assertions automatically; failure is not an oracle
// for correct bidi behavior and never counts as an E2 success.
func TestE2MarkupAdmissionProbe(t *testing.T) {
	input := textInput("aa bb \uFFFC אב גד הו 12 (xy) zz")
	input.Atomics = []contracts.AtomicAnchor{{ID: 1, ByteOffset: 6}}
	input.Markup = func(at uint64) int {
		if at == 10 {
			return bidi.MarkupRLI
		}
		if at == input.Text.Raw().Len() {
			return bidi.MarkupPDI
		}
		return 0
	}
	p, err := paragraph.Prepare(t.Context(), input, khipu.PrepareOptions{}, flowConfig(new(serviceCalls)))
	if err != nil {
		var stage *paragraph.Error
		if errors.As(err, &stage) && stage.Stage == paragraph.StagePrepare && strings.Contains(err.Error(), "invalid logical bidi segment") {
			t.Skipf("unsupported before E2: ordinary paragraph.Prepare rejects this markup fixture: %v", err)
		}
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	req := flowRequest(paragraph.FirstFit)
	req.Atomics = []paragraph.AtomicBox{{ID: 1, BorderWidth: 5 * dimen.BP, BorderHeight: 22 * dimen.BP, Alignment: paragraph.AlignBottomMarginEdge}}
	seed, err := p.FlowStart(t.Context(), req)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	ha := seed.Initial().VList.Lines()[0].Height
	ref, err := flowToFrames(t.Context(), p, seed, ha, 30*dimen.BP, 1000, false)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	got, err := flowToFrames(t.Context(), p, seed, ha, 30*dimen.BP, 1000, true)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	compareFlow(t, seed.Initial(), ref, got, 1, 30*dimen.BP)
}
